ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Pluto

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Look at an old photograph and remember where your strength comes from.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Reply to that message you keep leaving for later.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Value your time: do not work for free for people who can pay.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between Venus and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.
